thesis.core_thesis: SMCI screens optically cheap (14.3x P/E, 0.53x P/S) but the full evidence does not support a long. The Q3 FY2026 -$6.62B operating cash outflow, a flagged Beneish M-score of +0.54 and a $520M gap between cash and 12-month debt maturities make trailing earnings an unreliable anchor. That leaves no clean edge in either direction.
